lastCompletedStory.title: Pre-emptively isolate the five non-failing implementer-side supervisor test files

nextStoryContext:
US-006 (CAM-420) applied the audit F-03 alternative (a) configPath-fixture idiom, mirroring US-003/US-004/US-005 of this PRD, to the five implementer-side supervisor test files that the auditor measured as contributing ZERO failures under today's codex-backend flip (pre-emptive isolation, no live signal, per the story's honesty label): test/supervisor/implement-blocked-marker-wiring.test.ts, test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts, test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts, test/notify/resend.test.ts, and test/supervisor/suggestion-filing-hook.test.ts. All five already had a Partial<RunSupervisorOptions> overrides builder (makeBaseOpts x4, makeReviewOpts x1, makeDummySupervisorOpts x1), so each got a module-level GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH fixture (own mkdtempSync dir, `[backend]
implementer = "claude"
` project.toml, afterAll cleanup) plus one added line in its builder's return object: `configPath: 'configPath' in overrides ? overrides.configPath : GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH,` -- the exact idiom from loop.test.ts's GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH precedent (US-003, CAM-420). Three of the five (notify-orchestrator.test.ts, resend.test.ts) needed new node:fs/node:os/node:path imports added (mkdtempSync/writeFileSync/rmSync, tmpdir, join) since they previously had none of those imports; the other three already imported everything needed. AC1's grep oracle (`grep -q "'configPath' in overrides" <file>` for each of the five files) passes for all five. Verification: the five files individually run 69 pass / 0 fail; full `bun test` is unchanged at 5633 pass / 0 fail (no tests added/removed, only fixture wiring, matching the story's honesty label that no dress-rehearsal fail-count drop is claimed here); `bun run typecheck` clean; `bun run check:all` fully green after raising two files' file-size-budget.json ceilings to their gate-measured content.split('
').length counts (notify-orchestrator.test.ts 412->434, suggestion-filing-hook.test.ts 628->647; the other three of the five stayed within their existing ceilings and needed no raise) with a dated _ref note naming this story and CAM-420, staged in the same commit. This completes the pre-emptive isolation of all 7 implementer-side supervisor test files named across US-005/US-006 of this PRD's audit scope (2 signal-bearing builder-less files in US-005, these 5 non-failing builder-having files in US-006); any future story adding a NEW runSupervisor/runSidecarLoop call site with an inline (non-overrides-builder-routed) opts literal in any of these 7 files must add its own `configPath: GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH` sibling key to keep the isolation intact.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-fixture DI-isolation story, mirroring US-003/US-004/US-005 of this same PRD exactly: no new external library surface introduced. RunSupervisorOptions.configPath already existed (US-001 of this PRD) and was already wired into readPhaseBackend/resolvePhaseModel; this story only threaded the pre-existing seam into five more builder-having test files' overrides builders.
